title: Winter Wonderland
text: Winter Wonderland. The pictures don't do it justice. These snowflakes along with some fishing line and tape turned out living room into a winter wonderland. We had a Christmas eve dance party for the littles and these were so perfect with strobe lights.

product_metadata.title: 46Pcs Plastic Snowflake Ornament Christmas Glitter Snowflake Hanging Christmas Tree Decorations with Silver Rope for Winter Decorations Tree Window Door Accessories (Golden)
features: 【VALUABLE PACK】You will get a package of 46pcs plastic glittery white snowflake decorations for Christmas with ropes; two shapes with 3 sizes, Snowflakes are flexible, good quality, and easily grab onto garland, etc. Silver string included in the bag to hang individually.

【PREMIUM MATERIAL】The glittery white snowflake ornaments are well made of hard plastic with sparkly glitter, gorgeous and reusable, these Christmas hanging snowflake decorations are light in weight, good to match all your other Christmas decorations.

【SNOWFLAKE CHRISTMAS DECORATIONS】You can string the snowflake pieces up by connecting the pre-punched holes and then hang on target places to make your Christmas tree or other decoration delicate and attractive.

【FESTIVE ATMOSPHERE CREATOR】Hang them at different heights in your windows to create beautiful winter wonderland party decorations. These would add a beautiful touch to your Christmas party. Sparkling Christmas snowflake decorations are great additions to any Christmas themed decor.

【SUITABLE OCCASIONS】Christmas tree hanging ornaments decorative, Christmas house decoration, white Christmas ornaments for crafts, snowflake decorations party, it's up to you, just brighten your festival with these glittered snowflakes ornaments.
